submissions.title: Corneal Collagen Cross-Linking (CXL): The 'Sub-400nm' Revolution for Ectasia Management
submissions.summary: Corneal Collagen Cross-linking (CXL) is a transformative, minimally invasive ophthalmic procedure utilizing ultraviolet A (UVA) light (specifically in the 'sub-400nm' range, typically 365-370nm) and a photosensitizer, riboflavin, to biomechanically stiffen the corneal stroma. This process effectively halts the progression of ectatic corneal diseases like keratoconus and post-LASIK ectasia, preserving vision and preventing the need for corneal transplantation.
